author: More Perfect Union
description:
Billionaire NFL owners can move their teams to other cities or sell chunks of them to private equity.

The Green Bay Packers can’t do either because they’re the only team in the NFL that’s owned by fans.

Now their model is under threat from a league flooded with cash.

Producer: Jake Cimperman
Editor: Ben Johnson
Motion Designer: Gerald Lane
Videographer: Rachael Hastings, Joel Van Haren, Fábio Erdos
Video Production Manager: Isabel Atalaya
Video Production Coordinator: Jodi Clemens

More Perfect Union is an Emmy-winning, nonprofit newsroom whose mission is to build power for working people. Here’s what that means: We report on the real struggles and challenges of the working class from a working-class perspective. We attempt to connect those problems to potential solutions. We report on the abuses and wrongdoing of corporate power. And we seek to hold accountable the ultra-rich who have too much power over America’s political and economic systems.

title: We Investigated The Only NFL Team Without A Billionaire Owner

author: More Perfect Union
description:
A $800 million severance for David Zaslav, instant layoff announcement, immense debt — the Paramount merger turned toxic immediately.

This Warner Brothers worker breaks down how the mega-corp, Skydance, is hiding thousands of layoffs, like his own.

It’s a trick CEOs and corporations use to hide the real damage of their deals.
title: I'm a Warner Bros worker. David Ellison is killing thousands of jobs like mine
